# AWS Infrastructure as Code

Author, validate, deploy, and troubleshoot AWS infrastructure as code directly in the main agent: CDK, CloudFormation (cfn-lint/cfn-guard), AWS Blocks, CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy CI/CD, and guided launches.

## How it works

This is a **vertical plugin**: its skills, commands, and MCP servers attach directly to your main agent, with no sub-agent hand-off. Prefer the [`aws-iac-engineer`](../../agent-plugins/aws-iac-engineer) or [`aws-deployment-agent`](../../agent-plugins/aws-deployment-agent) agent plugin when you want an isolated specialist instead.

- Install: `claude plugin install aws-infrastructure-as-code@talkops-devops-plugins`
- Skills activate from their descriptions; invoke one explicitly with `/aws-infrastructure-as-code:<skill>`

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| `aws-blocks` | Guides building full-stack applications with AWS Blocks — an Infrastructure-from-Code framework. |
| `aws-cdk` | Authors, deploys, and troubleshoots AWS infrastructure using CDK with TypeScript or Python. |
| `aws-cloudformation` | Authors, validates, and troubleshoots AWS CloudFormation templates. |
| `aws-deployment` | Configures CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeConnections, and CodeArtifact. |
| `launch-with-aws` | Migrates vibe-coded web applications to AWS. |

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/aws-infrastructure-as-code:cdk-preflight` | Synth, lint, and diff a CDK app before deploying |
| `/aws-infrastructure-as-code:pipeline` | Design or fix a CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy CI/CD pipeline |
| `/aws-infrastructure-as-code:troubleshoot-stack` | Diagnose a failed or stuck CloudFormation stack |
| `/aws-infrastructure-as-code:validate-template` | Validate a CloudFormation/SAM template with cfn-lint and cfn-guard |

## MCP servers

Declared in [`.mcp.json`](./.mcp.json); started when the plugin is enabled and available to the main agent.

| Server | Transport | Launch | Tool names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-mcp` | stdio | `uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli==1.7.0` `--skip-auth --metadata` | `mcp__plugin_aws-infrastructure-as-code_aws-mcp__*` | Managed AWS MCP Server via the toolkit's pinned proxy (aws___call_aws, aws___search_documentation, aws___retrieve_skill, ...). |
| `awsiac` | stdio | `uvx awslabs.aws-iac-mcp-server@latest` | `mcp__plugin_aws-infrastructure-as-code_awsiac__*` |  |

AWS credentials are inherited from the host environment (`AWS_PROFILE`, SSO, or instance role). `AWS_REGION` defaults to `us-east-1` when unset. Toggle any server off per project in `/mcp`.
